architecture.mechanism: Polystyrene-supported heterogeneous organocatalyst enabling fixed-phase reaction under neat conditions for continuous flow processing.
architecture.intervention: Integrate a polystyrene-bound hydrophilic polymer matrix with chelating groups into the inline filter cartridge to capture fine coolant particulates and contaminants via specific chemical affinity, allowing for continuous flow filtration without phase separation issues.
architecture.expected_effect: The filter cartridge achieves >90% particulate capture in a 50 mm line over a 90-day cycle and can be replaced via manifold isolation without draining the coolant loop, preventing heat rejection loss.
architecture.falsification_test: Run a 90-day continuous flow test of the modified cartridge in a 50 mm line with seeded coolant; verify particulate capture efficiency remains >90% at day 90 and confirm zero loop drainage is required during cartridge replacement.
